Astrokillah wrote: Rinehart, was there a reason for you to not wanting to short at level-A (on my chart)?

cheers

Astro

You partially answered your own question. It was a set and forget
trade. I was comfortable taking the QM trade and of course risking a
stop out if it was a DM. I would not have been comfortable with FL A.
Another reason I wouldn't have liked FL A as much is because of zone B
right above it. Two zones like that in close proximity is a good FO
target. If I traded A, I would be afraid of the FO and would have to
put my SL much bigger. This hurts the R/R alot so better to only play
B.
